text:
marta: Postmortem follow-up for Obsidian dedicated tenant. Symptom: short tenant isolation gaps during scheduled failover. Looks like stale conntrack on their appliance + fast reannounce from peering. Need owners for remediation, CI validation, monitoring, and customer coord. @sanjay @lena please take.

sanjay: I’ll own peering-side fixes. Plan: add 30s re-announce suppress, dedupe in route-prop, and a withdraw-if-flap-safe fallback. Will open PR + rollback doc. ETA: Wed EOD.

lena: I’ll run the on-prem audit with Obsidian ops. Checklist: conntrack dumps, NAT settings, kernel/fw versions, iptables. If vendor patch required we need a temporary CT-prune shim. Need maintenance window.

vika: Intro DM to Obsidian ops sent. Filed ticket INC-5601 and suggested two maintenance windows.

ops-bot: Ticket created: INC-5601 "Obsidian peering / conntrack investigation"  assignee: net-ops  https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-5601

marta: Monitoring asks: add Grafana panel + alerts for route_flap_rate and conntrack_reassoc_ratio. Alert if route_flap_rate > 3/5m OR conntrack_reassoc_ratio > 0.7% in 5m. @sanjay please add panel and alert.

sanjay: Will add queries and alert rule, route slack to #incidents and page on critical. Draft query for flap: sum(rate(route_flap_total{customer="obsidian"}[5m])) by (peer). For conntrack ratio: sum(rate(conntrack_reassoc_total{customer="obsidian"}[5m])) / max(1, sum(rate(conntrack_total{customer="obsidian"}[5m]))).

lena: Note: Obsidian has one edge on vendor fw v2.2 (has known NAT issues). I’ll capture exact versions in INC-5601 and propose mitigation options there.

marta: Action summary (added to postmortem doc): 1) sanjay - route suppress + dedupe + alerts (PR -> #PR-1199) ETA Wed EOD; 2) lena - on-prem audit + vendor escalation (INC-5601) ETA Mon next week; 3) CI e2e (owner: eng-qa) - simulate asymmetric paths & conntrack churn ETA next Fri; 4) customer coordination (vika) - confirm maintenance window ETA tomorrow. Short sync Tue 09:30 PT. Please update INC-5601 with milestones and paste PR/test links as they land. :white_check_mark:
